cohort: 23,894 parturient women in Brazil, of whom 20.9% had undergone a previous cesarean section
finding: The majority (85.1%) of women with a previous cesarean section underwent another cesarean section, with VBAC rates influenced by factors such as choosing vaginal birth, prior vaginal birth, cervical dilation on admission, healthcare system, and presence of complications.
